name: Can I fix a sticking sliding glass door myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I fix a sticking sliding glass door myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor issues like cleaning the track can sometimes be a DIY fix, more complex problems usually require professional help. Replacing rollers, repairing a bent track, or addressing issues with the door's alignment can be challenging and require specific tools and expertise. Attempting complex repairs without proper knowledge might lead to further damage. A professional can diagnose the problem accurately and ensure a lasting repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can clean the track yourself, but complex repairs like roller replacement or track alignment are best handled by a professional to avoid further damage.
